Text: Øger skaden. +15% til +130% og x1.06 til x1.75 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases damage. +15% to +130% and x1.06 to x1.75 over 10 levels.
Increases kitten damage. +35% to +350% over 10 levels.

Text: Tilføjer killinger. De angriber fjender på egen hånd. +1 til +10 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Adds kittens. They attack enemies on their own. +1 to +10 over 10 levels.

Text: Låser auraen op: den skader hver fjende inden for sin radius. Låser opgraderingen Auraradius op.
Source: Unlocks the aura: it damages every enemy inside its radius. Unlocks the Aura Radius upgrade.

Text: Øger auraskaden. x1.18 til x3 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases aura damage. x1.18 to x3 over 10 levels.

Text: Øger auraradius permanent. x1.08 til x2 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases aura radius permanently. x1.08 to x2 over 10 levels.

Text: Låser Spring op ({pounce}): 2 s af din skade på én gang. x5 mod en fjende med skjoldet nede.
Source: Unlocks Pounce ({pounce}): 2s of your damage at once. x5 on an enemy whose shield is down.

Text: Øger springskaden. x1.18 til x2.9 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases Pounce damage. x1.18 to x2.9 over 10 levels.

Text: Spring udløses af sig selv, når det er klar, med x1.1 skade. Det får ingen x5-skjoldbonus.
Source: Pounce fires automatically when ready, at x1.1 damage. It gets no x5 shield bonus.

Text: Låser overkill op: skade ud over et drab. 10% af den rammer den nærmeste fjende.
Source: Unlocks overkill: damage past a kill. 10% of it hits the nearest enemy.

Text: Øger den overkill, der rammer den nærmeste fjende. +4.5% til +28% over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases the overkill that hits the nearest enemy. +4.5% to +28% over 10 levels.

Text: Katten rider på Enhjørningen. Låser Enhjørningens færdigheder op.
Source: The cat rides the Unicorn. Unlocks the Unicorn skills.

Text: Låser Regnbuebæ op: hvert 8. sekund en pyt, der skader fjender i 3 s.
Source: Unlocks Rainbow Poop: every 8s, a puddle that damages enemies for 3s.

Text: Øger skaden fra Regnbuebæ. x1.3 til x4 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases Rainbow Poop damage. x1.3 to x4 over 10 levels.

Text: Øger Kattemynte pr. drab og gyldne fjender. Kattemynte x1.038 til x1.268, chance for gylden +0.5% til +5%.
Source: Increases Catnip per kill and Golden enemies. Catnip x1.038 to x1.268, Golden chance +0.5% to +5%.

Text: Jordfjender er 40% langsommere overalt. Flyvere bremses ikke.
Source: Ground enemies move 40% slower everywhere. Fliers are not slowed.

Text: Øger Snarens opbremsning. 44% til 80% over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases the Snare slow. 44% to 80% over 10 levels.

Text: En fjende, der er ved at slippe væk, vender om. 1 til 3 gange pr. fjende over 10 niveauer.
Source: An enemy about to escape turns back. 1 to 3 times per enemy over 10 levels.

Text: Fjender dræbt under 20% helbred giver mere Kattemynte. x1.1 til x2 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Enemies killed below 20% health give more Catnip. x1.1 to x2 over 10 levels.

Text: Enhjørningen skyder en stråle mod den nærmeste fjende. Den giver 35% af din auraskade.
Source: The Unicorn fires a beam at the nearest enemy. It deals 35% of your aura damage.

Text: Et drab med strålen hopper videre til den næste fjende. 1 til 5 hop over 10 niveauer.
Source: A beam kill jumps to the next enemy. 1 to 5 jumps over 10 levels.

Text: Drab med strålen giver mere Kattemynte. x1.15 til x2.5 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Beam kills give more Catnip. x1.15 to x2.5 over 10 levels.

Text: Strålen fejer og skader hver fjende, den krydser.
Source: The beam sweeps and damages every enemy it crosses.

Text: Drab med strålen taber skår. For hver 10 skår: 50% til 320% af auraskaden mod alle fjender.
Source: Beam kills drop shards. Every 10 shards: 50% to 320% of aura damage to all enemies.

Text: Hver runde starter med et forspring. Behold 5% til 50% af din Kattemynte. Opgraderinger starter på Niv. 2 til 26, i biom 2 til 6.
Source: Each run starts ahead. Keep 5% to 50% of your Catnip. Upgrades start at Lv 2 to 26, in biome 2 to 6.
Paw damage x2.5. Aura radius x0.5.

Text: Springskade x4. Springlås: du kan ikke bevæge dig i 3 s efter hvert Spring.
Source: Pounce damage x4. Pounce lock: you cannot move for 3s after each Pounce.
Aura radius x1.6. Aura damage x0.65.

Text: Auraskade x2.2. Killinger giver ingen skade.
Source: Aura damage x2.2. Kittens deal no damage.

Text: +1 kort i hver hånd. Skade x0.8.
Source: +1 card in every hand. Damage x0.8.

Text: Skade x1.1. Kattemynte x1.1. Ingen ulempe.
Source: Damage x1.1. Catnip x1.1. No downside.

Text: Kritchance +10%, derefter x3. Kritskade x2.5. Angrebshastighed x0.5.
Source: Crit chance +10%, then x3. Crit damage x2.5. Attack speed x0.5.
Spawn rate x2. Enemy health x1.6.

Text: Øger Flænsning pr. stak. +0.5% til +5% over 10 niveauer. Fordobler loftet for opgraderingen Flænsning.
Source: Increases Shred per stack. +0.5% to +5% over 10 levels. Doubles the Shred upgrade's cap.

Text: Start hver runde med ekstra omtræk. +1 til +5 over 5 niveauer.
Source: Start each run with extra rerolls. +1 to +5 over 5 levels.

Text: Øger skaden for hver genopvågning, du har gjort. +1% til +5% pr. genopvågning over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases damage for each Reawaken done. +1% to +5% per Reawaken over 10 levels.

Text: Øger skaden mod fangede fjender. x1.1 til x2 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases damage to snared enemies. x1.1 to x2 over 10 levels.

Text: Hver ny bølge betaler renter af din Kattemynte. +0.2% til +2% over 10 niveauer.
Source: Each new wave pays interest on your Catnip. +0.2% to +2% over 10 levels.

Text: Hvert drab forkorter springlåsen. -0.05 s til -0.5 s pr. drab over 10 niveauer.
Source: Each kill shortens the Pounce lock. -0.05s to -0.5s per kill over 10 levels.

Text: At stå stille øger auraradius, helt efter 3 s. +5% til +50% over 10 niveauer.
Source: Standing still increases aura radius, in full after 3s. +5% to +50% over 10 levels.

Text: Jordfjender driver mod dig. 10% til 100% styrke over 10 niveauer.
Source: Ground enemies drift toward you. 10% to 100% strength over 10 levels.

Text: Hvert drab i denne bølge øger Kattemynte pr. drab, op til 100 drab. +0.2% til +2% pr. drab.
Source: Each kill this wave increases Catnip per kill, up to 100 kills. +0.2% to +2% per kill.

Text: Øger kritskaden med et erhverv, der sænker angrebshastigheden. +6% til +60% over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases crit damage with a job that lowers attack speed. +6% to +60% over 10 levels.

Text: Undslupne fjender giver stadig Kattemynte: 5% til 50% af den over 10 niveauer.
Source: Escaped enemies still give Catnip. 5% to 50% of it over 10 levels.

Text: At stå stille sparer Kattemynte op, helt efter 10 s. Dit næste drab giver lige så meget som 0.5 til 5 drab.
Source: Standing still banks Catnip, in full after 10s. Your next kill adds 0.5 to 5 kills' worth.

Text: Hvert 100. drab giver x20 til x200 Kattemynte over 10 niveauer.
Source: Every 100th kill gives x20 to x200 Catnip over 10 levels.

Text: Hvert drab øger spawnraten med 10% til 100%, op til +200%. Den aftager med 35% pr. sekund.
Source: Each kill increases spawn rate by 10% to 100%, up to +200%. It fades by 35% per second.

Text: En fjende forsvinder med 20 til 6 s mellemrum over 10 niveauer. Bosser forsvinder aldrig.
Source: An enemy vanishes every 20s to 6s over 10 levels. Bosses never vanish.

Text: Nogle poteangreb rammer to gange: 5% til 50% af angrebene over 10 niveauer.
Source: Some paw attacks hit twice. 5% to 50% of attacks over 10 levels.

Text: Under springlåsen brænder jorden under dig: 20% til 200% af din skade.
Source: During the Pounce lock, the ground under you burns. 20% to 200% of your damage.

Text: En anden aura følger 1 s efter dig: 10% til 100% af din skade over 10 niveauer.
Source: A second aura trails 1s behind you. 10% to 100% of your damage over 10 levels.

Text: Efter et krit kan det næste poteangreb dræbe med det samme. 5% til 50% chance over 10 niveauer.
Source: After a crit, the next paw attack can kill instantly. 5% to 50% chance over 10 levels.

Text: Se en del af den næste hånd, mens du vælger. 1 til 3 kort over 3 niveauer.
Source: See part of the next hand while you choose. 1 to 3 cards over 3 levels.

Text: Hvert 10. angreb er et krit. At skifte mål beholder tællingen.
Source: Every 10th attack is a crit. Switching targets keeps the count.

Text: Hvert 6. sekund giver auraen 1 s af sin skade på én gang.
Source: Every 6s, the aura deals 1s of its damage at once.

Text: Markerer, hvor den næste særlige fjende dukker op.
Source: Marks where the next signature enemy will spawn.

Text: Få 1% af din Kattemynte hvert minut.
Source: Gain 1% of your Catnip every minute.

Text: Flyvere nær fangede fjender bevæger sig med 60% fart.
Source: Fliers near snared enemies move at 60% speed.

Text: Poteangreb rammer også op til 3 fjender bag målet.
Source: Paw attacks also hit up to 3 enemies behind the target.

Text: +4% auraskade for hver fjende i auraen.
Source: +4% aura damage for each enemy inside the aura.

Text: Overkill giver ekstra Kattemynte: op til +100% af drabets Kattemynte.
Source: Overkill gives extra Catnip: up to +100% of the kill's Catnip.

Text: Krit kommer efter en fast tælling, ikke tilfældigt. Samme gennemsnit.
Source: Crits come on a fixed count, not at random. Same average.

Text: Fjender dukker op i en ring 280 px omkring dig, ikke ved kanterne.
Source: Enemies spawn in a ring 280px around you, not at the edges.

Text: Et Spring, der ikke dræber noget, har ingen nedkøling.
Source: A Pounce that kills nothing has no cooldown.

Text: Killingerne vender tilbage, uden skade. De trækker fjender nær dem ind i din aura.
Source: Kittens return, without damage. They pull enemies near them into your aura.

Text: Bær et andet erhverv med 50% styrke, med fordele og ulemper.
Source: Wear a second job at 50% strength, upsides and downsides.

Text: Køb en boss' Madding for Kattemynte, for x3 dens pris i Kattemynte.
Source: Buy a boss's Bait with Catnip, at x3 its Catnip price.

Text: 1 kort i hver hånd er 1 niveau højere.
Source: 1 card in every hand is 1 level higher.

Text: Øger spawnraten. x1.1 til x2.5 over 10 niveauer. Stakker med opgraderingen Spawnrate.
Source: Increases spawn rate. x1.1 to x2.5 over 10 levels. Stacks with the Spawn Rate upgrade.

Text: Rejs til det næste biom, når det låses op. Du kan slå det fra i Riger.
Source: Travel to the next biome when it unlocks. You can turn it off in Realms.

Text: Tilkalder bossen, så snart du har dens Madding. Aldrig under en kamp.
Source: Summons the boss as soon as you have its Bait. Never during a fight.

Text: Kort vælges for dig uden pause. Du kan slå det fra i Fangster.
Source: Cards are picked for you without pausing. You can turn it off in Catches.

Text: Øger skaden, mens der er 40 eller flere fjender på skærmen. x1.05 til x1.6 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases damage while 40 or more enemies are on screen. x1.05 to x1.6 over 10 levels.

Text: Øger skaden, mens der er færre end 5 fjender på skærmen. x1.2 til x3 over 10 niveauer.
Source: Increases damage while under 5 enemies are on screen. x1.2 to x3 over 10 levels.

Text: Overkill på 10 gange en fjendes helbred taber en kattemyntebombe.
Source: Overkill of 10 times an enemy's health drops a Catnip bomb.

Text: +0.5% til +5% skade pr. bølge i dette biom. Nulstilles, når du rejser.
Source: +0.5% to +5% damage per wave in this biome. Resets when you travel.

Text: +1% til +10% skade pr. kort taget i denne runde. Nulstilles ved genopvågning.
Source: +1% to +10% damage per card taken this run. Resets when you Reawaken.

Text: +1% til +10% skade pr. 10.000 drab i denne runde. Nulstilles ved genopvågning.
Source: +1% to +10% damage per 10,000 kills this run. Resets when you Reawaken.

Text: Killinger angriber, hvor fjenderne er tættest, ikke den nærmeste fjende.
Source: Kittens attack where enemies are densest, not the nearest enemy.

Text: Hver niveaustigning giver omtræk. +1 til +5 over 5 niveauer.
Source: Each level up gives rerolls. +1 to +5 over 5 levels.

Text: Killinger får en del af din kritchance: 10% til 100% over 10 niveauer.
Source: Kittens get part of your crit chance. 10% to 100% over 10 levels.

Text: Genopvågning giver halvdelen af sit Stjernestøv nu. Den anden halvdel kommer, når du når Byens tage.
Source: Reawaken gives half its Stardust now. The other half comes when you reach City Rooftops.

Text: Fanen Riger viser hvert bioms Kattemyntebelønning.
Source: The Realms tab shows each biome's Catnip reward.

Text: Madding tjent i ét biom tæller i alle biomer.
Source: Bait earned in one biome counts in every biome.
